question_code:
Three security lights flash at different regular intervals.
Light $P$ flashes every 42 seconds, Light $Q$ flashes every 60 seconds, and Light $R$ flashes every $t$ seconds, where $t$ is an integer such that $60 < t < 100$.
All three lights flash together at exactly 18:00.
They next flash together at exactly 18:14.
[ENUM_START]

\examanswerslot{2cm}{0.25}{2}
[ITEM] Find the total number of seconds between 18:00 and 18:14.
\examanswerslot{2cm}{0.25}{1}
[ITEM] Determine the two possible values of $t$.
\examanswerslot{2cm}{0.25}{3}

The universal set $U = \{x \mid x \text{ is an integer and } 1 \le x \le 10\}$.

$$P = \{x \mid x \text{ is a prime number}\}$$

$$Q = \{x \mid x \text{ is an even number}\}$$

$$R = \{1, 2, 4, 8\}$$


[ENUM_START]
[ITEM] List the elements of the set $P \cap Q \cap R$.
\examanswerslot{2cm}{0.25}{1}

\examanswerslot{3.5cm}{0}{1}
[ITEM] Find the value of $\text{n}(P \cup Q)$.
\examanswerslot{2cm}{0.25}{2}
[ENUM_END]
